reader.requirement: At --std 85 GENERATE report-name-1 performs summary processing: the report heading, page and control headings/footings and control-break processing run as for GENERATE data-name, and the single detail group (if any) is processed through 11a-11d (its subtotalling and its USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure run) but is never presented; when every GENERATE of a report is the report-name form, no detail group is presented. With no detail group, step 11a still runs as though one existed.

edition-consulted.switches: ctx.Edition.DialectLevel < 2002: the 85-only SR6 refusal of the report-name form when the RD has more than one detail group (COBOL6823)

DialectBehavior.GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate on CobolReport.Edition: whether a GENERATE that did not present a detail consumes the GROUP INDICATE occasion (85 keys it to presentation); on the detail-name arm only
emits `{ Edition = DialectLevel }` on each CobolReport, the value GenerateCore reads

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the summary path (GenerateSummary -> GenerateCore with printDetail false -> BeginGroup(print: false)) is the same at every edition; the 85 arms are SR6's refusal and GROUP INDICATE consumption, neither of which changes what a report-name GENERATE presents
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c12 mixes detail and summary GENERATEs and has no SUM, no declarative and no FINAL footing; an all-summary report, the detail's subtotalling and USE procedure under the report-name form, and a report with no detail group are covered only by probes

probes.expected: all GENERATEs are GENERATE R-1: no DE line anywhere (summary report); the detail's SUM AMT subtotalling runs on each (11a: 10+20=30, 5; FINAL 35); its USE BEFORE REPORTING runs each time (11b: 3)
a report with no detail group (SR6: not required when no GENERATE data-name is written) still sums per 11a and presents no detail

probes.printed: error COBOL6823 ... holds 2 detail report groups ... (ISO §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6); error COBOL0899 GENERATE R-2: the report-name form requires a CONTROL clause
probes.expected: the report-name form refused for an RD with two details (85 arm) and for one without CONTROL (XIII.4.3.3 SR2a/b)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR1  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: BindGenerate binds the report-name form to BoundGenerate with SummaryDetail set to the sole detail, the emitter calls GenerateSummary, and GenerateCore runs the group prologue for that detail with print: false, matching TYPE GR11 a-d. The all-summary report printed no detail line and kept its subtotals.

refuter.evidence: Probe r4summ.cob (--std 85; PAGE LIMIT 6 HEADING 1 FIRST DETAIL 2 LAST DETAIL 5; the detail has LINE PLUS 2 NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE, a GROUP INDICATE item and is the UPON object of SUM AMT UPON DE1): four GENERATE R-1 left LINE-COUNTER at 1 and PAGE-COUNTER at 1 (G1 and G4 LC=1, PC=1), so the summary detail processed no LINE and no NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE (§1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR11d, 'there is no further processing done for the report group'); the PH was presented at the first GENERATE (GR5b); the control break printed CF100 = 10+20+30+40 (SUM ... UPON DE1 subtotalled on the summary GENERATEs, 11a); the USE BEFORE REPORTING DE1 ran on every GENERATE (USE-RUNS=6, 11b); a later GENERATE DE1 after the break presented DE06 with the group-indicated K1 (the summary GENERATE did not consume the GROUP INDICATE occasion), and CF011 = 5+6 at TERMINATE. Probe r4nobody.cob: an RD with CONTROL and no body group is refused (COBOL2749). (The COBOL2199 refusals beside it in r4nobody and r4body are correct: with PAGE LIMIT 10 and no HEADING/FIRST DETAIL, integer-2 = integer-3 = 1 and the page heading region is empty, §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR8b, cite.py OK.) cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR1; OK §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR11d.
